title: Week 7 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “bicameralism”?
options: A classification receiving especially demanding judicial review, such as race under equal-protection doctrine.
A legislature composed of two chambers.
A professional public workforce selected and managed through established personnel systems.
Constitutional requirements of fair law, notice, procedure, and impartial decision-making before government deprives life, liberty, or property.
questions.explanation: Bicameralism means a legislature composed of two chambers.
choices: A classification receiving especially demanding judicial review, such as race under equal-protection doctrine.

A professional public workforce selected and managed through established personnel systems.
Constitutional requirements of fair law, notice, procedure, and impartial decision-making before government deprives life, liberty, or property.

The ability to access, analyze, evaluate, create, and verify messages across media forms.
The people and interests represented by an elected official.
